items.title: Slime Imposters
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Check out these slimy imposters, who do they think they are? Oh right, they think they're super cool astronauts, pirates, spies and everything in between! 

- Super slimy HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Diamond Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Get hyped and roam around the city with modern fashion! Be on trend and make the streets your own hallway. Choose your fashion that fits your free spirit best and dazzle the creepers. Start your Minecraft adventure with your own style!

- Includes 20 modern fashioned skins to choose
- Perfect for multiplayer

items.title: MEGA Castle
items.creator: Jigarbov Productions
items.description:
Tired of regular-sized castles? How about a MEGA Castle! This is a meticulously crafted castle made MEGA with mega blocks. Each mega block is made up of smaller blocks, you'll be playing survival in a whole new way. Complete the plaque monument!

+ Castle made of MEGA blocks.
+ Lots of challenges to complete!
By Jigarbov Productions

items.title: Rabbits
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Spring is back! Enjoy a ride in the city with these colorful bunnies. You might find some hidden chocolate eggs! You can only find them when you are dressed in your bunny costume!

+ 1 free skin
+ 15 bunny skins

items.title: Elite of Anime
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you become a part of the upper echelon? Can you make it to the top? With this skin-pack you might be within arm's reach of becoming one of the most elite anime characters, the likes of which the world has yet to see! 

- 10 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Ninja Impostors
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
They’ll never guess you are among them. Role-play as a ninja impostor, and you’ll never get caught! Choose from 12 different secret skins and stay perfectly hidden. Will they find out who did it? The mystery puzzle may never be solved when a skilled ancient Japanese spy is around.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Dragon Teens
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Teen, dragon, or both!! Have fun role-playing and adventuring as one of these fun, colorful dragon characters. From a cosplaying teen to a fiery red dragon, to a mystical wyvern, and more! Who will you choose to be?

items.title: Dyed Hair Teens
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Explore the future! It's time to dye your hair and join the party. Try different hair colors, dress up with the most modern style and be the trendiest among your friends with 12 new outfits! Steal the spotlight and rock your free world with this vibrant skin pack. 

+ 12 teen skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Geo Suits
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
With a combination of fancy suits and sleek geometric patterns, you will stand out in any crowd with the 'Geo Suits' skin set! 

- 8 unique skins
- Wide variety of geometric patterns and snazzy looking suits!

items.title: Skyblock Lucky Heads
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Are you feeling lucky? Enjoy fun times together with your friends with these skyblock inspired skins!

- 8 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Demons HD
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: They are cute, they have attitudes, and they are joining your Minecraft party - meet the Demons! This pack includes colorful demon characters for you and your friends to play as. Perfect for exploring, going to school and practicing magic together!

items.title: Power Robots
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Power up and power on! With 12 colorful options to choose from, become super strong and high-tech. Role-play as a really powerful and indestructible robot and be unbeatable. No one will be able to stop you — you’re a tough, unbreakable bot.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Aesthetics
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Everyone enjoys different things. But one thing is certain; this pack will have a skin that you'll like! 

*12 stylish skins
*2 skins free

items.title: Masked Mobs HD
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Masked mobs return but this time in high definition! Are you bored of vanilla mobs? Then spice up your game with this cool and mysterious skin pack! No one will ever call you boring once you start wearing them!

- 12 skins
- By RareLoot

items.title: Music DJs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Hey there DJ, put some music on! Get the party and the dancing started when you play the best tunes. Choose from 8 awesome DJ skins and role-play a cool club scene. Scratch and mix geared up in headphones and mic to turn up the songs and the crowd!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Mob Knights
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
With their tough armor and diamond swords, these mob knights are ready for any quest that comes their way!

- 8 medieval skins to choose from!
- Includes Creeper, Enderman, Pig, Zombie, and many more!

items.title: Dinosaur Land
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Can you survive in the daring era of the mighty dinosaurs? Explore their land and uncover all of the secrets hidden in their land by our ancestors. Are you ready to get immersed?

-A great prehistoric adventure
-Including Cave
-Stunning survival spawn
-By RareLoot

items.title: Kidnap in the City
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome to the moving city, created with wood and scrap metal from the ground up by its hardworking citizens. But beware, a kidnap took place here and you are the detective, the one that will find the kidnapper and put them behind bars.

- Riddles
- Escape room
- Interactive NPCs
- By Enigma

items.title: Among Sus 4
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Space explorers come one come all! Colorful astronauts are here and make cute roleplaying skins for you and your friends. Roleplay as friendly and evil astronauts. You'll never guess who among you is actually a scary space alien!

- 35 astronaut skins

items.title: Shark
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Enjoy the ultimate Minecraft collection of famous YouTuber Shark!
Whether you want to equip Shark's skin or look like a member of his crew, this pack has it all!

+ 12 shark skin variations, bringing the best vibes from the bottom of the ocean!
+ A loyal fan or you simply like these skins? Join the squad today!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

+ In partnership with Shark!

items.title: Fairy Tales Teen
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ready for an adventure in the wonderful world? Play as your favorite fairy tale character.

- 2 free skins
- 32 awesome skins
- Perfect for role-playing
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Overtales Studio.

items.title: Anime Teens Academy
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Do you want to have amazing powers? Then we present you the Anime Teens Academy. Decide your own path and train your skills being a ninja, a magician or a boy with supernatural powers; discover what best represents you in the anime world.

-Ten beautiful skins.
-One skin totally free.
-Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Teen Style: Space Hoodies
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Teen Style: Space Hoodies brings space to Minecraft, pick your favorite and be ready for interstellar fashion!

28 HD (128px) skins including:

- 2 free!
- 9 space hoodie skins with 2 variations each


1 Exclusive skin by: Dannny0117

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.title: Scary Villagers
items.creator: Diveblocks
items.description: It's time to scare your friends with Scary Villagers. These skins will haunt your nightmares and anyone who gets close to them. Stay spooky!
